description.narrative: About the urgency of our proposal we are quite short: the climate crisis is the greatest threat ever to human nature, but decision makers refuse to act accordingly. In the meantime millions of people worldwide lose their lives, incomes and future, while nature isdeclining at an unprecedented rate. Only if we act quickly and decisively, we can still turn the tide. That is exactly what young climate activists do. Only if they have our full support we can change the tide. Oxfam Novib, Extinction RebellionNetherlands and Fridays For Future Netherlands want movements of young climate activists to become stronger, become more inclusive and grow. In this project we put all our innovative power to make that change happen. In this project, we ask young climateactivists worldwide what theyneed and stand squarely behind them. We support their struggle – that also is ours– with training, supporting networks that increase their influence and with funds the can use as required. We build bridges between individuals, grassroots and more established organizations, in between old and new allies. We give young climate activists resources to battle climate change together, more powerful and to perform more effectively. Together we create the well-equipped platform TIPPINGPOINT for and by young people climate activists, where they can meet, learn, strengthen themselves and make plans together. They can also apply for funding. Together we make the movements stronger and more inclusive, so that groups worldwide are better able to tackle climate change.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
